messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout r-6912: service=redwood-runtime model=rrt-v1.2.3 -> 20% traffic now (us-west, eu-west). change-window ends 02:00 UTC. Monitor: latency, 5xx, embed-error-rate. Docs: https://internal/runbooks/rollouts
carla: seeing a small spike in eu-west 5xxs, +2.8% over baseline. Not huge but trending up. :thinking_face:
ben: can you paste the top error?
carla: `500 internal: kvcache-miss -> mem alloc failed`
alice: kvcache OOMs again? which pool is hit?
david: looks like small batch nodes in eu-west-b are at 92% mem. Possibly q4 quantized kernels spike memory.
eva: rolling 20% includes a few heavy routes hitting long sequences — that could cause sustained KV growth.
carla: error rate correlated with requests with seq_len>4096. We just started routing a content client that does chunked prompts.
ben: ops: whats the impact percentile? p95 latency fine, p99 latency +120ms in eu-west. 5xx spike about ~3% of requests in that region.
sre-oncall: tag me, I'm watching. Do we want an immediate stop or canary hold?
david: my call: hold the progressive ramp and pin current EU nodes to rrt-v1.2.2 until we confirm KV leak is mitigated.
eva: agree with pin. We can still keep us-west at 20% if it's clean, but isolate eu-west traffic back to previous variant.
carla: +1 pin eu-west. Also recommended: throttle long-seq routes to fallback model.
ben: who will execute the pin? I can run deploy-bot pin command if we get consensus.
sre-oncall: consensus: pause eu-west portion, pin to v1.2.2. us-west remains at 20% for now. Vote: proceed with pin?
alice: +1 pin eu-west.
david: +1
eva: +1
ben: +1 I'll run it in 2 mins.
carla: adding a quick smoke: run `curl /health?seq=5000` against pinned vs canary to confirm.
deploy-bot: r-6912: executing traffic pin -> region=eu-west target_version=rrt-v1.2.2 user=ben
deploy-bot: r-6912: traffic pin completed. eu-west now serving rrt-v1.2.2 (pinned). us-west still on rrt-v1.2.3 20%.
carla: monitoring... 5xxs dropping already. p99 tail normalizing. good catch all. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: nice. Keep the canary paused until we push a fix or we validate changes in a small controlled sample. Action items: 1) eng-runtime to investigate kv cache memory growth (owner: david) 2) qa to run long-seq smoke set (owner: alice) 3) product to notify affected client (owner: carla) 4) ops to prepare safe-unpin playbook (owner: ben).
david: will dig into kernel selection logs and quantization path. pulling traces now.
alice: I'll start the smoke set and post results here.
eva: if we need to mitigate quickly we can enable `sequence_slicing=true` for the client route as a circuit breaker.
ben: noted. I'll keep the rollback plan ready if we see regression in us-west.
carla: thanks everyone — pin worked and change-window still has buffer. We'll reconvene once david has root cause or earlier if anything changes.
deploy-bot: r-6912: status=paused_region eu-west pinned, overall rollout state=partial-hold.
